info.name: UniMart API Collection (Backend Specs)
info.description: This collection contains pre-configured test requests to verify the UniMart campus marketplace REST APIs. It covers service health checks, user registration, JWT logins, user profile management (/me), category creation, and product listing catalog retrieval.

item.name: System Diagnostics
item.description: Endpoints to check if the backend application is running and verify active database connectivity.

request.description: Checks the status of the unimart-backend service and probes the local MySQL database. It executes a test query (`SELECT 1`) to check if the database connection is fully up and running. Response status will show `CONNECTED` if successful.
A simple public heartbeat ping checks if the Spring Boot application server is responsive. Returns `UP` status and the current timestamp.

item.name: Authentication & Accounts
item.description: Handles user registration, session tokens management, and user profile operations.

request.description: Creates a new user profile in the database. The `universityEmail` must be a valid, unique email address. The password will be hashed securely via BCrypt before saving. Returns user details, excluding the password hash, with HTTP Status 201 (Created).

Authenticates the user by comparing credentials. If successful, generates and returns a signed JWT Bearer token containing scopes and user information. Copy the token from the response for secure requests.
Retrieves the currently authenticated user's profile details. Requires Bearer Token authorization header.
Updates editable profile fields (fullName) for the currently authenticated user.

item.name: Categories Management
item.description: APIs to set up and query active product catalog categories.

request.description: Registers a new product/service category (e.g. Textbooks, Electronics, Services). Category names must be unique. Active defaults to `true`.
Lists all active categories in the system. Use this to get valid category IDs prior to posting a listing.

item.name: Marketplace Listings
item.description: APIs to create, filter, and fetch campus listings.

request.description: Creates a product listing. Pre-validates that `sellerId` and `categoryId` refer to existing records in the database. Validates that the price is positive. Optimistic locking defaults to version 1.

body.raw:
{
  "sellerId": 1,
  "categoryId": 1,
  "title": "Introduction to Java Programming Textbook",
  "description": "Like-new condition. Essential reference for level 2 B.Sc. IT modules.",
  "price": 2500.00
}

request.description: Fetches all listings currently posted on the marketplace. Supports an optional `categoryId` query parameter to filter by category: `GET /api/v1/listings?categoryId=1`.
Fetches the full details of a single catalog listing matching the supplied `id` path parameter, including seller name and category name.
